desc: Sheldon sits on the couch, whiteboard and flags behind him, reaches over and picks up a toy figurine off of the end table.
Will Wheaton, with a blue flag in his hand, joins Sheldon on the couch.
Amy nods her head left and right, and then straight up, while standing behind the camera on the tripod.
Amy, in a brown sweater and pink shirt, opens her mouth in surprise while standing near the kitchen.
Sheldon hands Will a figurine from the glass table and gets up from the couch.
Howard runs up and opens the dresser drawer, then takes out a red cloth, while Bernadette stands in the doorway.
Howard, all in turquoise, takes red clothing and puts it on his chair next to his desk.
Leonard, with crossed arms, briefly scratches his nose while he is standing beside Sheldon sitting at his desk with a laptop.
Leonard, in purple hoodie and jacket, looks uncomfortable and touches his brow while he is standing beside Sheldon sitting at his desk with a laptop.
A shot of the laptop screen, where Amy reaches forward and presses a button that shuts the video off.
Penny, at a restaurant, carries two plates of burgers and sets them in front of Howard and Bernadette, who is wearing a blue sweater.
Howard lifts his hands up and aside, with a burger in one hand, at the restaurant.
Sheldon, at the doorway, gets a box from a red paper bag and handed it to Amy.
Someone shoves a box into Sheldon's chest and closes the door.
Leonard is closing a box with packing tape, while Howard is taking a light-saber off the wall of his bedroom, behind him.
Leonard looks at the doorframe and points at it with a marker.
Raj and Leonard carry boxes out of the room, while Howard, in a yellow shirt, takes something covered in a purple blanket.
Sheldon enters the bar and sits on a stool in front of Penny, with a snack lying on the bar counter.
Penny pretends to throw up while standing behind the bar with a snack lying on the bar counter.
Penny, standing in front of Sheldon at the bar, fills a glass with soda from the tap.
Sheldon takes the last sip of his drink with a red straw and ice, then sets the glass down on the bar.
Sheldon quickly drinks his whole drink while holding a red straw, then makes a happy face, at the bar.
Howard struggles to carry a large box into the room, leaning his whole body into it to set it down on the ground.
Howard takes the magic wand out of the box and sits beside Bernadette on the couch.
Bernadette, angry, got up from the couch suddenly and grabbed a cardboard box, then left the apartment.
Bernadette hugs Howard, standing next to a cardboard box lying on the orange chair.
Sheldon, in a beige-and-white jacket, knocks on the door with his whole fist, light glowing in the windows behind the curtains.
Sheldon taps the wall threateningly while talking to Will.
Sheldon holds up his fists and moves them in front of Will, while talking.
Sheldon lowers his fist and takes a step back while steadying himself against the wall with his hand.
Sheldon places his hand on Will's chest and then walks away to lean against the porch railing.
Sheldon stumbles up to the porch of someone's house at night and knock on the doors.
A guy in an orange sweater walks over, shakes Sheldon's hand, and sits down on the couch, with a whiteboard and flags behind it.
